elements.style: white rounded square with coral flag/check glyph

behavior.onFailure: show 'Something went wrong' card with Retry and 'Export what I have'; never wipe data automatically

splash.animation: logo scales 0.9 to 1 with fade (base), tagline fades in 150ms later; reduce motion: static

behavior.onMount: check getEnrolledLevelAsync(); if NONE go to lockRequired; else call authenticate automatically
behavior.accepts: phone password, PIN or pattern; biometrics if enrolled on the phone
behavior.onSuccess: go to home (or deep link target if opened from a notification)
behavior.onCancelOrFail: stay on lock; show 'Not unlocked' and keep the UNLOCK button; no custom PIN, no bypass
behavior.relock: when app is backgrounded longer than settings.lockTimeout (default 30s; options Immediately, 30s, 1 min, 5 min)
privacy: block screenshots and the recents preview with expo-screen-capture on all screens
no data is rendered on the lock screen

lock.a11y: UNLOCK button labelled; prompt text is system-provided

elements.value: padlock in coral on soft tint
ProTrack keeps payment records, so it only opens on phones protected by a password, PIN or pattern.

lockRequired.behavior: re-check automatically on AppState active; when a lock is found, continue to lock screen. No other navigation is possible.
